title: Microsoft Teams: download manager with improved visibility and control
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly treats existing file-access controls as unconfirmed for this download experience. Microsoft documents that SharePoint Conditional Access also applies to Teams and can block file downloads in Teams clients. The roadmap details, product-level licensing and absence of a separate download-manager switch are otherwise supported.
